name: memory_search
description:
Full-text searches across all memory: facts, strategy notes, and checkpoint metadata.
Use when: locating a fact whose key you don't remember, finding which checkpoint contains certain context, or auditing what the agent knows.
Scope: local filesystem. No network access.
Not for: reading a specific fact by key (use memory_read), restoring a checkpoint (use memory_restore).

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword or phrase to search across all memory sources.
